outcome: antenatal diagnosis of morbidly adherent placenta
cohort: The study included 89 pregnant women diagnosed with placenta previa, excluding primigravida and those with pregnancies complicated by diabetes, heart disease, or hypertension.
finding: Grey ultrasonography demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy (97.10%) in the prenatal detection of morbidly adherent placenta, with a specificity of 98.36% and sensitivity of 87.5%.
